groups.title: One after another
groups.rule: Choose the focus: 接连 = separate events close together; 连续 = an unbroken run; 陆续 = staggered arrivals; 先后 = order. 相继 overlaps with 接连/陆续 but is more written; 一连 stresses a count; 一再 stresses repeated attempts or occasions; 接着 moves to the next action; 不断 means keeps happening.

members.cue: Separate events happen close together; often repeated hits.
members.pattern: 接连收到三条坏消息

members.cue: An unbroken run or duration, often counted.
members.pattern: 连续工作三天

members.cue: People or events arrive at staggered times over a period.
members.pattern: 客人陆续到达

members.cue: Emphasizes which happened first and which later; no closeness required.
members.pattern: 先后在北京和上海工作

members.cue: People or events follow one another; more written, overlapping with 接连/陆续.
members.pattern: 几家公司相继宣布涨价

members.cue: Several things in a row, emphasizing the number; overlaps with 连续.
members.pattern: 一连问了三个问题

members.cue: The same action happens repeatedly on separate occasions, often despite reminders or setbacks.
members.pattern: 我一再提醒他

members.cue: Then: move from one action to the next action.
members.pattern: 吃完饭，接着去看电影

members.cue: Something keeps happening or developing, without emphasizing a count.
members.pattern: 问题不断出现

groups.rule: Both mean if; choose the conversational alternative only when casual register is the point.

members.cue: Neutral default for if; works in speech and writing.
members.pattern: 如果 A，就 B

members.cue: Conversational if; casual alternative to the neutral default.
members.pattern: 要是 A，就 B

groups.rule: Use a time anchor for after X; use a connector for the next step, X and then Y.

members.cue: After X or after that; a time expression.
members.pattern: X 之后，Y

members.cue: Then or and then; introduces the next action.
members.pattern: X，然后 Y

groups.rule: English trap: regarding A introduces a topic; regard A as B assigns A an identity.

members.cue: Regarding or as for a topic.
members.pattern: 对于 A，…

members.cue: Treat or think of A as B.
members.pattern: 把 A 当成 B

groups.rule: A present emotion answers how you feel; optimism answers how you view the situation or future.

members.cue: Happy or glad now; having a good time.
members.pattern: 感到很开心 / 玩得很开心

members.cue: Optimistic; expects a good outcome or sees the positive side.
members.pattern: 对…感到乐观 / 保持乐观

groups.rule: Both mean happy; 开心 is the everyday spoken choice for feeling glad or having fun, while 快乐 is standard in greetings and general or abstract talk about happiness.

members.cue: Happy/happiness in greetings, wishes, and general or abstract descriptions.
members.pattern: 生日快乐; 快乐的生活; 追求快乐

members.cue: Conversationally feel glad, be in a good mood, or have a good time.
members.pattern: 见到你很开心; 玩得很开心; 不开心

groups.rule: Anxiety answers how you feel; worry answers what person or outcome you fear.

members.cue: An anxious state; does not directly take the feared thing.
members.pattern: 感到焦虑 / 对…感到焦虑

members.cue: Worry about a specific person, thing, or possible outcome.
members.pattern: 担心 + person, thing, or clause

groups.rule: A feature is a neutral point you can list; distinctive character is what gives something its identity.

members.cue: Distinctive character or specialty; identity-giving and often showcaseable.
members.pattern: 以…为特色 / 特色菜

members.cue: Neutral identifiable feature or trait; may be good, bad, or descriptive.
members.pattern: 主要特点是…

groups.rule: One states a judgment reached by assessment; the other accepts something as true or places trust in someone.

members.cue: Hold or state an opinion; judge something to be the case.
members.pattern: 认为 + clause / 被认为是…

members.cue: Believe a claim is true or trust a person.
members.pattern: 相信 + person or clause

groups.rule: Clearly defined content has no ambiguity; an obvious conclusion is evident from what you observe.

members.cue: Definite and unambiguous; specify or make explicit.
members.pattern: 明确的目标 / 明确责任

members.cue: Obviously or evidently; evaluates a whole statement.
members.pattern: 显然，… / subject + 显然 + predicate

groups.rule: Have the experience, gain understanding from it, or show an abstract quality outwardly.

members.cue: Personally undergo or try an activity, situation, product, or service.
members.pattern: 体验生活 / 用户体验

members.cue: Understand or appreciate something through lived experience.
members.pattern: 体会到 + feeling, truth, or difficulty

members.cue: Embody or visibly demonstrate an abstract quality.
members.pattern: A 体现了 B / B 体现在 A 上

groups.rule: Use the formal or commercial adult category versus the everyday grown-up contrasted with a child.

members.cue: Adult as a formal or commercial category; adult-only.
members.pattern: 成人票 / 成人教育

members.cue: Everyday grown-up contrasted with a child; historical honorific.
members.pattern: 一个大人两个小孩

groups.rule: A person is a genius; a person has natural aptitude.

members.cue: An exceptionally gifted person.
members.pattern: 是个天才 / 数学天才

members.cue: Natural aptitude or gift that someone possesses.
members.pattern: 有天分 / 在…方面有天分

groups.rule: Performance can be measured as good or bad; an accomplishment is inherently positive and meaningful.

members.cue: Grades, scores, or measurable performance and results.
members.pattern: 成绩好或差 / 考试成绩

members.cue: Significant positive accomplishment, often substantial or lasting.
members.pattern: 取得成就 / 伟大的成就

groups.rule: Something itself makes progress; someone deliberately improves a specific thing.

members.cue: The person, skill, or society gets better; normally no direct object.
members.pattern: X 进步了 / 取得进步

members.cue: Improve or refine a method, product, process, or work; takes an object.
members.pattern: 改进 + thing

groups.rule: Actively use something, judge it useful in practice, or adjust yourself to a new situation.

members.cue: Use, employ, or operate a tool, method, app, word, or resource.
members.pattern: 使用 + object

members.cue: Practical, useful, or functional in the real world.
members.pattern: 很实用 / 实用的 + noun

members.cue: Adapt to or get used to an environment, rhythm, system, or change.
members.pattern: 适应 + new condition

groups.rule: No delay, a moment or constant state, or early enough to meet the need.

members.cue: Immediately; one action happens with no delay.
members.pattern: 立刻 + action

members.cue: A moment; or constantly and at all times.
members.pattern: 重要时刻 / 时刻准备着

members.cue: Timely or in time; early enough to help or prevent a problem.
members.pattern: 及时 + action

groups.rule: 反复 repeats the same action or state; 陆续 sequences separate people or events over time.

members.cue: The same thing happens repeatedly, possibly stopping and restarting.
members.pattern: 反复 + action; state + 反复

members.cue: Different people or events occur one after another at staggered times.
members.pattern: people/events + 陆续 + action

groups.rule: 出版 puts a book or periodical into publication; 出行 means making a trip or traveling.

members.cue: Publish a book, magazine, or other edition.
members.pattern: 出版 + book/periodical; 由…出版

members.cue: Go out or travel, especially in traffic and trip-planning contexts.
members.pattern: 出行方式; 绿色出行; 出行高峰

groups.rule: 明显 describes a noticeable feature, difference, or change; 显然 marks the speaker's evident conclusion about a situation.

members.cue: Something is perceptibly noticeable or stands out.
members.pattern: 明显的 + noun; result/change + 很明显

members.cue: The evidence makes a whole conclusion clearly true.
members.pattern: subject + 显然 + predicate; 显然，+ clause

groups.rule: 显然 marks a conclusion; 显得 links a subject to an appearance; 显著 marks significant degree; 显示 displays or indicates information.

members.cue: Clearly or evidently: the speaker draws an obvious conclusion.
members.pattern: subject + 显然 + predicate; 显然，+ clause

members.cue: Look or seem: a subject gives a particular impression.
members.pattern: subject + 显得 + adjective/descriptive phrase

members.cue: Significant or marked: a difference, effect, or change is notable in degree.
members.pattern: 显著 + change; 显著的 + difference; result + 显著

members.cue: Show, display, or indicate information, data, evidence, or content.
members.pattern: screen/data/research + 显示 + content/result

groups.rule: 来自 gives a broad origin or source; 出自 attributes a quotation, work, or product to a specific text, creator, maker, or producer.

members.cue: Come from: broad geographic, personal, material, or abstract origin.
members.pattern: person/thing/information + 来自 + origin

members.cue: Be from or by: specific attribution or provenance of something created or quoted.
members.pattern: quotation/work/product + 出自 + text/creator/maker

groups.rule: 反复 presents repetition as an iterative process or recurring state; 一再 stresses occasion after occasion, often with an implied 'and still'; 不已 follows one unceasing reaction.

members.cue: A process loops or is revisited; a state can recur, fluctuate, or relapse.
members.pattern: 反复 + action; state + 反复

members.cue: Again and again on separate occasions, often implying 'despite this' or 'and still.'
members.pattern: 一再 + verb

members.cue: Unceasingly: a formal post-verbal complement for one continuing reaction.
members.pattern: emotion or reaction + 不已

groups.rule: 即使 introduces a concession: even if X, Y still holds; 自从 establishes a past starting point: since X, Y has been true.

members.cue: Even if/even though: X does not change the outcome.
members.pattern: 即使 + condition, 也 + outcome

members.cue: Ever since: X is the past point from which a situation continues.
members.pattern: 自从 + past event, 就/一直 + continuing situation

groups.rule: 体验 is undergoing something firsthand; 体会 is the understanding or feeling gained from it; 经验 is accumulated practical know-how you retain and reuse.

members.cue: Live or try something firsthand: the experience itself.
members.pattern: 体验生活; 亲身体验; 用户体验

members.cue: Come to appreciate or understand something through lived experience.
members.pattern: 体会到 + insight; 深有体会; 谈体会

members.cue: Accumulated practical knowledge or expertise available for future use.
members.pattern: 有经验; 积累经验; 工作经验

groups.rule: 勤快 is colloquial and emphasizes readily staying busy and getting practical tasks done; 勤劳 describes sustained hard work as a broader trait or virtue.

members.cue: Active and quick to do everyday work; visibly not lazy.
members.pattern: 手脚勤快; 干活很勤快

members.cue: Hardworking and industrious as an enduring character trait.
members.pattern: 勤劳的人; 勤劳的人民; 勤劳勇敢

groups.rule: 一路 says an action or state continues all the way through a journey; 途中 locates an event at some point during the journey.

members.cue: All the way: the action continues across the route or journey.
members.pattern: 一路 + action; 一路上; 一路平安

members.cue: On the way: an event occurs somewhere between departure and arrival.
members.pattern: 在 + journey + 途中; journey + 途中

groups.rule: 再三 presents someone deliberately repeating an action for emphasis, caution, persuasion, or careful thought; 反复 presents a process looping or a state recurring.

members.cue: Deliberately do it several times to insist, make sure, persuade, or think carefully.
members.pattern: 再三 + deliberate action

members.cue: A process is revisited or repeated, or a condition keeps returning or fluctuating.
members.pattern: 反复 + action; condition + 反复

groups.rule: 逐渐 and 渐渐 both describe a continuous gradual change; 逐渐 is the more neutral or written choice, while 渐渐 is more conversational. 逐步 instead presents progress through successive steps or stages.

members.cue: Gradually: the neutral or more written member of the 逐渐/渐渐 near-synonym pair.
members.pattern: 逐渐 + change in state, amount, or degree

members.cue: Gradually or little by little: conversational counterpart of 逐渐.
members.pattern: 渐渐 + change or new state

members.cue: Step by step: a process advances through successive stages.
members.pattern: 逐步 + advance, establish, implement, solve, improve

groups.rule: 自主 concerns having control and making choices independently; 自觉 concerns voluntarily doing what one knows should be done, without reminders or supervision.

members.cue: Self-directed: you control the decision, method, or activity rather than someone else controlling it.
members.pattern: 自主 + choose, decide, learn, develop, operate

members.cue: Conscientiously and voluntarily: you do it without needing to be told, reminded, or watched.
members.pattern: 很自觉; 自觉 + obey, queue, study

groups.rule: 努力 emphasizes working hard or putting in substantial effort; 尽力 means using all the effort or ability available, often for a particular task whose success is not guaranteed.

members.cue: Work hard: describes the intensity or sustained amount of effort.
members.pattern: 努力 + activity; 很努力

members.cue: Do everything one can: effort up to the limit of one's ability or circumstances.
members.pattern: 尽力 + accomplish or help; 尽力而为

groups.rule: 辩论 presents opposing sides giving reasoned arguments about an issue, often in a structured setting; 争论 presents people disagreeing and arguing over who or what is right.

members.cue: Debate: opposing sides develop arguments and respond to each other's reasoning.
members.pattern: 围绕 issue 辩论; 辩论赛

members.cue: Argue or dispute: people disagree over an issue; it may be calm or heated.
members.pattern: 为/关于 issue 争论; 一场争论

groups.rule: Both describe tiredness; 疲惫 usually means deeper physical or mental exhaustion, while 疲倦 more directly describes feeling tired or weary and wanting rest.

members.cue: Exhausted or worn out: a stronger, often whole-body or mental state.
members.pattern: 身心疲惫; 疲惫不堪; 一脸疲惫

members.cue: Tired or weary: the felt need to rest after activity or insufficient rest.
members.pattern: 感到疲倦; 疲倦的神情; 不知疲倦

groups.rule: 相比 explicitly names the comparison benchmark; 相对 describes a non-absolute degree or relation, often with the benchmark left implicit.

members.cue: relatively; relative: qualify a degree or relation rather than name a comparison partner
members.pattern: 相对 + adjective/noun; 相对于 + benchmark

members.cue: compared with: explicitly set up the thing being used as the benchmark
members.pattern: 和/与/跟 + A + 相比

groups.rule: 对象 is the noun for the person or thing an action is directed at; 对应 describes two things matching or corresponding.

members.cue: object, target, or person being studied/served; also a romantic partner
members.pattern: 研究/服务 + 对象; 找对象

members.cue: to correspond or match: expresses the relationship between counterparts
members.pattern: A 对应 B; 对应的 + noun; 与 A 相对应

groups.title: Ways to lead
groups.rule: 先 = ahead; 路 = route; 动 = set in motion; 指 = point out how. 带领 and 率领 overlap: everyday lead vs formal head.

members.cue: Be ahead of competitors in score, rank, or progress.
members.pattern: 领 lead + 先 first; 领先两分

members.cue: Lead a group through an activity; the everyday choice (formal counterpart: 率领).
members.pattern: 带 take along + 领 lead; 带领大家参观

members.cue: Head a group on an undertaking; formal counterpart to 带领, not necessarily a large group.
members.pattern: 率 command + 领 lead; 率领球队夺冠

members.cue: Direct an organization or people over time; also the leader.
members.pattern: 领 lead + 导 guide; 领导一家公司

members.cue: Guide someone's thinking or behavior.
members.pattern: 引 draw along + 导 guide; 引导学生思考

members.cue: Give instruction or expert guidance on how to do something.
members.pattern: 指 point out + 导 guide; 指导工作

members.cue: Set a direction or trend that others follow; formal.
members.pattern: 引 draw forward + 领 lead; 引领潮流

members.cue: Spur growth, activity, or enthusiasm into motion.
members.pattern: 带 take along + 动 move; 带动经济发展

members.cue: Show someone the physical route.
members.pattern: 带 take along + 路 road; 请人带路

members.cue: A person who guides others through unfamiliar terrain.
members.pattern: 向 direction + 导 guide; 请个向导

groups.rule: Both mean 'as much as possible'; 尽量 is the conversational default for trying, while 尽可能 explicitly maximizes the degree that circumstances permit.

members.cue: as X as possible: maximize a possible degree under the circumstances
members.pattern: 尽可能 + 早/快/多/少/详细; 尽可能（地）+ verb

members.cue: try to; as much as you can: conversational default emphasizing effort
members.pattern: 尽量 + verb/adjective

groups.rule: For a personal A/B choice, both can mean 'lean toward.' Outside that overlap, 倾向 describes a neutral general tendency, while 偏向 means favoring one side and may imply bias.

members.cue: neutral inclination or general tendency, including patterns without a conscious choice
members.pattern: 倾向于 + option/action; 有 + behavior + 的倾向

members.cue: lean toward or favor one side; overlaps with 倾向 for personal choices but can imply bias
members.pattern: 偏向 + side/person; （比较）偏向于 + option

groups.rule: 获得 focuses on the resulting gain or possession; 获取 names the acquisition, access, or retrieval operation, whose completion depends on aspect and context.

members.cue: receive, gain, win, or be granted something as a result
members.pattern: 获得 + 奖项/机会/批准/支持/学位

members.cue: acquire, access, fetch, or retrieve: the acquisition operation
members.pattern: 获取 + 信息/数据/资源/权限

groups.rule: 展示 focuses on presenting something for others to see; 展现 focuses on a quality, side, or scene becoming visible or apparent.

members.cue: deliberately show, present, or display something to others
members.pattern: 向 + person + 展示 + thing

members.cue: reveal or manifest a quality; come into view
members.pattern: 展现(出) + quality/side; scene + 展现在...

groups.rule: 信念 is a conviction that a proposition or principle is true, right, or achievable; 信仰 is faith in or devotion to a religion, ideology, or overarching ideal.

members.cue: a firm personal conviction about what is true, right, or achievable
members.pattern: 一个信念：clause; 坚定/坚守信念

members.cue: faith in or adherence to a religion, ideology, or overarching ideal
members.pattern: 信仰 + religion/ideology; 宗教信仰; 有信仰

groups.title: Getting people interested
groups.rule: 营销 is the commercial strategy; 宣传 raises awareness; 推广 spreads use or reach; 广告 is an ad; 推销 pitches to a buyer; 促销 is a campaign to boost sales. These activities can overlap.

members.cue: commercial marketing strategy and activity
members.pattern: 品牌/内容营销

members.cue: publicize or raise awareness
members.pattern: 宣传活动/资料

members.cue: spread adoption or reach
members.pattern: 推广产品/技术

members.cue: an advertisement or advertising
members.pattern: 投放广告

members.cue: pitch a product directly to a buyer
members.pattern: 向人推销保险

members.cue: a campaign to boost sales
members.pattern: 搞促销/促销活动

groups.title: Selling and availability
groups.rule: 销售 is business language for selling; 出售 emphasizes offering an item for sale; 预售 happens before release; 零售 sells to individual consumers; 批发 sells in bulk to businesses. Everyday 'sell' is 卖.

members.cue: sell or sales, in business language
members.pattern: 销售汽车/销售额

members.cue: offer an item for sale
members.pattern: 出售房屋/股票

members.cue: sell before the official release
members.pattern: 门票开始预售

members.cue: sell to individual consumers
members.pattern: 零售/批发

members.cue: sell in bulk to resellers or businesses
members.pattern: 批发商品

groups.title: Launch, release, circulate
groups.rule: 推出 is the producer introducing something new; 上市 is a product reaching the market (or a company going public); 发布 announces or releases information or a product; 发行 distributes media, currency, or securities into circulation.

members.cue: introduce a new offering
members.pattern: 推出新产品/功能

members.cue: reach the market; also go public
members.pattern: 新品上市/公司上市

members.cue: announce or release information or a product
members.pattern: 发布消息/新品

members.cue: issue and distribute into circulation
members.pattern: 发行图书/股票
